name: ZombieFireworks
description: Every zombie that dies bursts into a customizable, colorful firework show with layered effects, particles, and sound.
usage: Kill a zombie and watch the sky light up
manual: Whenever a zombie dies, a firework launches from its corpse and detonates into a burst of color. The enabled knob (default true) turns the whole show on or off without disabling the mod. spawn-chance (default 1.0) is the probability, from 0 to 1, that any given zombie death triggers a firework. effects-per-firework (default 1, 1-4) stacks multiple color bursts into a single rocket for a denser show. firework-power (default 0, 0-3) controls how high the rocket flies before detonating - 0 pops almost instantly at ground level. launch-delay-ticks (default 2, 0-40) sets how long after launch the rocket detonates. color-mode (default random) picks the palette style: random picks independent colors per effect, monochrome uses one color for the whole firework, and rainbow cycles through a full spectrum across the stacked effects. flicker-chance and trail-chance (both default 0.5) are the odds, from 0 to 1, that each effect gets a flicker or trail sparkle. sound-volume (default 1.0, 0-2) scales the launch sound. A little cloud of colored dust particles also puffs out at the detonation point to make the moment pop even before the firework itself explodes.
creator: Rcon
